invariants.title: Money is integer cents; a match adds up to its row exactly, in the row's currency.
Statement = books - recorded here and not on the statement + on the statement and not in the books; a leftover difference is named.
A matched row posts nothing itself and cannot be reviewed again while matched; nothing is in two matches.
Only a row that posts nothing can be matched; a row already booked is refused, naming what it is.
Signing off is a person's act, refused to an agent, and refused while the difference is not zero or a row is unaccounted for.
A sign-off keeps the reconciliation as it stood; a later change shows as changed since.
Every write is a logged command with an actor; refusals are logged too.
